title: After a host restart, follow-up to a completed Codex child is refused as "archived manually" (terminal-release barrier not durable)
outcome: A follow-up to a completed Codex delegation child whose thread TermAl itself archived at terminal release still works after a host restart, while a genuinely manual archive is still refused.
acceptance: Whether the archive came from TermAl's own terminal release or from a manual Archive is decided from durable state, so it survives a host restart; a follow-up after a restart unarchives and proceeds for a TermAl terminal release.
A genuinely manual archive is still refused with the existing 'unarchive it before sending another prompt' message.
A behavioural test covers: terminal release, then host reload, then a follow-up that succeeds; and a manual archive, then host reload, then a follow-up that is refused.
